item.title: Projects
item.description:
Projects

Libraries, tools, and experiments I’ve built or contributed to. Each write-up explains the problem I was working on, how I approached it, and what came out of it.

For my work on Microsoft Graph SDKs, Kiota, and cloud platforms, see About. You can find more of my code on GitHub.
